card.name: Quantity numbers before units of weight
card.fires_on: Numbers and number-words (million, digits inside 100, 4000, 15) in a quantity right before a unit such as pounds, g or mg. Also 'per' and 'mg' inside unit phrases.

modes.label: Large amounts in pounds
modes.description: The word million after a number, in a count of pounds of antibiotics.

modes.label: Dose limits in grams or mg
modes.description: A digit within a numeric dose limit that is followed by g or mg.

modes.label: Unit pieces in rates
modes.description: The word per or mg inside a rate or weight-based dose.
modes.example: AVYCAZ 62.5<< mg>>/kg to a maximum of 2.
